results: Actual horizontal rational compact rank-four orthogonal projector from degree-one graph correspondences; no full-open-rank4 assumption.
Fixed-left-residue cup normalization gives kappa_raw=-(2*pi*i)^3/16 and kappa_dR=-1/16.
True node sphere period and actual Gamma period give Gamma dot delta=-8; scalar concomitant independently fixes kappa.
Exact self-adjoint P and conditional scalarization P nu = kappa*c*sqrt(x), including leading factor and dual sign.
If actual compact regulator derivative has c=+16, its normalized scalar satisfies the same inhomogeneous P4 equation as W, up to a still-undetermined homogeneous period.
not_claimed: Actual ell4 compact regulator derivative or equality to the positive-cut current.
Integral projector, trace matrix, lattice saturation or free Tate normalization.
Actual vanishing of the homogeneous period discrepancy.
A new numerical irrationality/linear-independence theorem, numerical PSLQ or Lean formalization.
